databases.description: PostgreSQL databases and schemas, including the first database. Add-only: PATCH must retain every existing database and schema. An omitted list keeps its value; an empty list is refused.

extensions.description: Extensions installed in the database, from the platform's allowlist. Each name is unique.

name.description: PostgreSQL name: lowercase letters, numbers and _, starting with a letter, at most 53 characters.

schemas.description: Schemas to create. Add-only, at most 20 per database; names are at most 63 characters. public, information_schema and pg_ names are reserved.

backupSizeBytes.description:
Bytes every full backup and all WAL kept for the database take up in storage, manual backups included.
0 until measured.

conditions.description:
Conditions include CredentialsRotating: True (reason RotationPending)
while a requested rotation is not yet applied, and, on a restored
database, Restored: True once the restore has finished.

currentVersion.description: CurrentVersion is the full engine version running.

databases.description: Progress for each PostgreSQL database. Ready covers provisioning and delivery; tenant SQL grants are separate.

lastBackupAt.description: When the newest full backup finished (RFC 3339). Empty until the first backup completes.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation the operator last reconciled.

previousVersion.description: PreviousVersion is set while a major upgrade is in progress.

recoveryWindow.description: The oldest and newest points you can recover the database to. Null until the backups report them.

rotations.description:
Rotations is the credential rotation state of each role. Wait for a
rotation by polling until rotations.{role}.appliedAt equals the
requestedAt the rotate-credentials call returned and delivered is
true. If requestedAt moves to another token first, a newer rotation
replaced it: wait for that one instead.

cluster.description: Cluster to bind into. It may not exist yet; the binding stays Pending until it does.

credentials.description: Give each listed namespace its own login and password. Required for custom; unavailable for owner.

logicalDatabase.description: PostgreSQL database to bind. Omit to use the instance's first database. Immutable.

namespaces.description:
Namespaces inside the cluster that receive the Service and credentials Secret: 1 to 10, each listed once,
none kube-* or argocd. PATCH the binding to add or remove namespaces.

role.description: Role granted: owner (changes the schema), readwrite (reads and writes data), readonly (reads data), or custom (a declared role).

roleName.description: Declared role to grant when role is custom. Required for custom; omitted for built-in roles.

secretName.description: Name of the credentials Secret in every listed namespace. Defaults to {database}-{role} for the first PostgreSQL database, or {database}-{logicalDatabase}-{role} for an added database. Logical names and custom roleName replace _ with -. A taken default is refused; set secretName to another name.

generation.description: Generation of the binding's requested settings; compare with status.observedGeneration.

logicalDatabase.description: Effective PostgreSQL database, including the source identity of a restored instance. Immutable.

namespaces.description: Namespaces are the namespaces the binding delivers into (1 to 10).

roleName.description: Declared role granted by a custom binding; empty for built-in roles.

secretName.description: SecretName as requested. For the first PostgreSQL database, defaults to {database}-{role}; for an added database, {database}-{logicalDatabase}-{role}. Logical names and custom roleName replace _ with -. A taken default is refused; set secretName to another name.
